verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document that a founder can book the audit through Oneleet, whether through a vetted auditor network or an in-house audit arm, and gives no audit-timeline expectations. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct support. The existence of an "Auditor API" shows auditors can work against the platform, but it is a developer building block, not an audit-booking service. The line about a pentest going "straight into your audit" concerns the pentest, not who performs or schedules the audit. The pricing page's "scope + timeline" refers to a sales quote, not a documented audit timeline.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline
